title: Mathematics.
description: Master Higher and Foundation tiers with strong problem-solving and reasoning skills across all six GCSE strands.

sections.title: Number
sections.text: Fractions, decimals, percentages, indices, surds, standard form and bounds.

sections.title: Algebra
sections.text: Expanding and factorising, solving equations, quadratics, simultaneous equations and graphs.

sections.title: Ratio and Proportion
sections.text: Direct and inverse proportion, compound measures and percentage change.

sections.title: Geometry
sections.text: Angles, circle theorems, trigonometry, similarity and vectors.

sections.title: Statistics
sections.text: Data representation, histograms, cumulative frequency and box plots.

sections.title: Probability
sections.text: Tree diagrams, Venn diagrams and conditional probability.
